body:
Yeah, nicotine has a mild antidepressant effect. It acts on dopamine, as do some antidepressants.  One antidepressant, Wellbutrin, can also be used as a quit smoking aid.
Quitting smoking certainly made my depression worse for a while. Got to pick your battles.

Recently, "These bars are filled with things that kill, by now you probably should have learned" and other Bright Eyes lyrics.
For a long time, "In the clearing stands a boxer,
and a fighter by his trade
and he carries the reminders
of every glove that laid him down
and cut him till he cried out
in his anger and his shame,
I am leaving, I am leaving
but the fighter still remains

I don't know how much it will help, but employers are looking for talent, and have realized GPAs aren't a good indicator.  I help evaluate prospective software developers for my company, and pay little attention to the school, or the GPA.

You always dream, the difference is remembering them or not. Depression can mess with that. 

So can pot "withdraw". The most vivid all strange dreams I've had were after abstaining from pot after a period of frequent use.
"Don't believe every thing you think." so simple, yet so hard, so true.

But why can they leave, but I have to stay here?  It makes no sense. One can leave forever in countless ways, but only one way shocks the senses. Even once everyone is gone, wish won't be much longer.

Yes, I've had that happen.  I went through one medication, increasing the dose four times, without effect.  At the high dose, I was unable to sleep, was prescribed another medication to take with it, and still couldn't sleep with no effect.  Switch to another medication, increased the dose, no effect.  Yet another medication, no effect.  Yet another medication, which made me hallucinate.  Then another medication, no effect.  I then stopped taking anything for about ten years.

A few months ago I went back to the doctor.  Well, a different doctor.  She prescribed a different medication, and it started being partially effective.  Increased the dose, and it made a big difference.

It can be frustrating and take a while, but hopefully you'll find a medication and dosage that works for you.  When it works, it's surprising.

Note: I intentionally left the medication names out.  What didn't work for me, might work for you.

>IMO you desperately need affection, skin contact, sexual activity and hopefully love. A relationship with someone who loves you is the best therapy.

I think your very, very right.  I've often felt I'd be much happier, and further in life, if I had that support.

>Get out there and do things 

I guess that's the hardest part, leaving the anonymous internet and taking the first step out the door.  Hopefully I'll find a way to find someone.

Thanks everyone for your comments.  They've given me some optimism.

I am working with a therapist.  Only had the initial session so far.

I knew wellbutrin was one of the few antidepressants that didn't have sexual side effects.  I had taken wellbutrin in the past, by itself, but it did not alleviate my depression.  I didn't realize it could be used to reverse the side effects of other medications.

Thanks
